review.rationale: Q001/002和4921扩展已答；Q003由SeerAPI反馈定义592/be8c58e4解决，非用户新回答。原17招白夜残秽源威力为0保留，以公共最低伤害前态验证正伤条件，未授予则零伤不推进。
review.singleBehavior: 起承转合当前持有者推进及10%减红与次数免异/免攻真实授予消费；实际珀萝来源ABC三技能匹配各异常、D任一异常仅将正技能红伤标为条件致死，不改数值，不绕免伤/护盾，保1完整伤仍推进。正常完整致死仍适用原规则。回合初敌有谋死最佳防御仅当前系别及子系，含属性附伤；否则末清敌回合成功再附加自身异常，自己保留，公共免疫可失败。
review.deferredBehavior: 己方真实队伍起承转合共享及其他当前或场下成员获得的次数免疫；无人生还令真实对方存活且持谋死成员在胜负结算中视为阵亡。
review.trigger: 战斗开始己方获得起，任意持对应谋死的真实成员受到致死伤害，或真实队伍胜负统计
futureMechanisms: 队伍共享状态与实际成员枚举

success.name: 4956/2153真实起初始化及无谋死战阶清敌回合，SeerAPI反馈只附加异常自身保留，免疫不移除自身
success.assertion: test('4956/2153真实起初始化及无谋死战阶清敌回合，SeerAPI反馈只附加异常自身保留，免疫不移除自身',()=>{const s=make({move:38589,soul:true});turn(s,38589,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.phase,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'],undefined);for(const immune of [0,1]){const x=make({move:38589,soul:true});x.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;x.fighters[1].counts.immune=immune;turn(x,38589,20117);assert.equal(x.round,2);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],3);assert.equal(!!x.fighters[1].ailments['中毒'],!immune);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.feedback[0].results[0].applied,!immune);}});

success.name: 4956/2153谋死持有者正常完整致死伤害推进各阶段并真实授免异或免攻，保1HP不要求实际死亡，恰等HP不推进
success.assertion: test('4956/2153谋死持有者正常完整致死伤害推进各阶段并真实授免异或免攻，保1HP不要求实际死亡，恰等HP不推进',()=>{for(const phase of[0,1,2,3]){const s=make({move:29480,index:-1,soul:true,targetHp:100});const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153;st.phase=phase;st.transitions=phase;timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});watch((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.t.soulState.murder2153=[phase];c.hurt(c.t,1000,'正常致死红伤非谋死替换','attack');}},()=>turn(s,29480,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.phase,phase+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.transitions,phase+1);if(phase===0)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);if(phase===1)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.guardRed,1);if(phase===2)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.guardAttack,1);}const x=make({move:29480,index:-1,soul:true,targetHp:100});timer(x,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});watch((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.t.soulState.murder2153=[0];c.hurt(c.t,100,'等于伤前HP','attack');}},()=>turn(x,29480,20117));assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.phase,0);});

success.name: 4956/2153每实际推进一次受红减少10，免攻次数真实消费且后续有HP损失，免异用统一来源账本
success.assertion: test('4956/2153每实际推进一次受红减少10，免攻次数真实消费且后续有HP损失，免异用统一来源账本',()=>{const a=make({move:38589,index:-1,soul:true}),b=make({move:38589,index:-1});a.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.transitions=2;turn(a,38589,10127);turn(b,38589,10127);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a,'attack',1)-sum(b,'attack',1)*.8)<=1);const x=make({move:38589,index:-1,soul:true});x.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.guardRed=1;turn(x,38589,10127);assert.equal(sum(x,'attack',1),0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.guardRed,0);turn(x,38589,10127);assert.ok(sum(x,'attack',1)>0);});

success.name: 4956已答ABC按真实中文首字与D异常视致死只推进剧情，红伤HP损失和原值不改变，条件失败不推进
success.assertion: test('4956已答ABC按真实中文首字与D异常视致死只推进剧情，红伤HP损失和原值不改变，条件失败不推进',()=>{for(const [phase,move,status]of [[0,38592,'害怕'],[1,38597,'流血'],[2,38598,'诅咒'],[3,38591,'中毒']])for(const active of [false,true]){const s=make({move,index:-1,soul:true}),b=make({move,index:-1});s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.phase=phase;s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.transitions=phase;for(const x of [s,b]){x.fighters[1].soulState.murder2153=[phase];if([1,2].includes(phase))timer(x,0,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:100});if(active)x.fighters[1].ailments[status]=3;}turn(s,move,20117);turn(b,move,20117);const red=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack');assert.ok(red.settledDamage>0&&red.settledDamage<9000);assert.equal(red.hpLoss,red.settledDamage);assert.equal(sum(s),sum(b));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,b.fighters[1].hp);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.phase,phase+(active?1:0));if(active&&phase===0)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);if(active&&phase===1)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.guardRed,1);if(active&&phase===2)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.guardAttack,1);}});

success.name: 4956已答免伤或整盾挡尽不视致死，保1HP完整正伤仍能推进；非对应ABC首字不推进
success.assertion: test('4956已答免伤或整盾挡尽不视致死，保1HP完整正伤仍能推进；非对应ABC首字不推进',()=>{for(const mode of ['immune','shield','floor','wrong-letter']){const move=mode==='wrong-letter'?38590:38592,s=make({move,index:-1,soul:true,targetHp:mode==='floor'?1:9000});s.fighters[1].soulState.murder2153=[0];s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');if(mode==='shield')s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=9000;if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(s,move,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.phase,mode==='floor'?1:0);if(['immune','shield'].includes(mode)){assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);}if(mode==='floor'){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack').hpLoss,0);}}});

success.assertion: test('4956/4动机命中加2，1866真实四种池均有机会且两种无放回、独立时长、免异不补抽',()=>{const s=make({move:29480});turn(s,29480,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.acc,2);const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=12;seed++){const x=make({move:29481,seed:seed*987654321});turn(x,29481,20117);const names=Object.keys(x.fighters[0].ailments);assert.equal(names.length,2);for(const k of names){assert.ok(['流血','沸涌','臣服','狂暴'].includes(k));assert.ok([2,3].includes(x.fighters[0].ailments[k]));seen.add(k);}const y=make({move:29481,seed:seed*987654321});y.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;turn(y,29481,20117);assert.equal(Object.keys(y.fighters[0].ailments).length,0);assert.equal(y.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);}assert.equal(seen.size,4);});

success.assertion: test('4956/4动机命中加2，1866真实四种池均有机会且两种无放回、独立时长、免异不补抽',()=>{const s=make({move:29480});turn(s,29480,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.acc,2);const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=12;seed++){const x=make({move:29481,seed:seed*987654321});turn(x,29481,20117);const names=Object.keys(x.fighters[0].ailments);assert.equal(names.length,2);for(const k of names){assert.ok(['流血','沸涌','臣服','狂暴'].includes(k));assert.ok([2,3].includes(x.fighters[0].ailments[k]));seen.add(k);}const y=make({move:29481,seed:seed*987654321});y.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;turn(y,29481,20117);assert.equal(Object.keys(y.fighters[0].ailments).length,0);assert.equal(y.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);}assert.equal(seen.size,4);});

interaction.name: 4956全部17招64种子基础命中暴击PP先制与2153完整原生有序链含反馈和谋死，不隔离分支
interaction.assertion: test('4956全部17招64种子基础命中暴击PP先制与2153完整原生有序链含反馈和谋死，不隔离分支',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(require('./helpers/remaining-4956.cjs'));for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}});

success.assertion: test('4956全部17招基础真实分类HP和源PP，零威力攻击保留零红事件，原先制与0PP拒绝',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,index:-1,aStats:{atk:180,spa:18}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,m.priority);const es=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack');assert.equal(es.length,m.kind==='status'?0:1,m.name);if(es.length){assert.equal(es[0].attackValue,m.kind==='physical'?180:18);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-es[0].hpLoss);assert.equal(es[0].settledDamage>0,m.power>0);}const z=make({move:m.id,index:-1});z.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(z,m.id,20117),/有 PP/);}});

success.name: 4956全部17招基础真实分类HP和源PP，零威力攻击保留零红事件，原先制与0PP拒绝
success.assertion: test('4956全部17招基础真实分类HP和源PP，零威力攻击保留零红事件，原先制与0PP拒绝',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,index:-1,aStats:{atk:180,spa:18}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,m.priority);const es=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack');assert.equal(es.length,m.kind==='status'?0:1,m.name);if(es.length){assert.equal(es[0].attackValue,m.kind==='physical'?180:18);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-es[0].hpLoss);assert.equal(es[0].settledDamage>0,m.power>0);}const z=make({move:m.id,index:-1});z.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(z,m.id,20117),/有 PP/);}});

success.name: 4956全部17招64种子基础命中暴击PP先制与2153完整原生有序链含反馈和谋死，不隔离分支

success.assertion: test('4956/1619复用已答复制完整敌已用技能、原槽PP与一次前判定，先手不复制，1673失败255下限与成功秒杀',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=16;seed++){const s=make({move:29484,index:0,aStats:{spe:1},seed:seed*987654321,hp:1000});turn(s,29484,10127);const copied=s.fighters[0].soulState.copyIdentityAudit16194658;if(copied){seen.add('copy');assert.equal(copied.copied,10127);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}else{seen.add('failure');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000-sum(s,'attack',1)+4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,-1);}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29484)],9);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);const first=make({move:29484,index:0,hp:1000});turn(first,29484,20117);assert.equal(first.fighters[0].hp,1000);const chance=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32&&chance.size<2;seed++){const x=make({move:29484,index:1,seed:seed*987654321});turn(x,29484,20117);chance.add(x.fighters[1].hp===0);if(x.fighters[1].hp>0)assert.equal(sum(x),0);}assert.equal(chance.size,2);});

success.name: 4956全部17招基础真实分类HP和源PP，零威力攻击保留零红事件，原先制与0PP拒绝
success.assertion: test('4956全部17招基础真实分类HP和源PP，零威力攻击保留零红事件，原先制与0PP拒绝',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,index:-1,aStats:{atk:180,spa:18}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,m.priority);const es=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack');assert.equal(es.length,m.kind==='status'?0:1,m.name);if(es.length){assert.equal(es[0].attackValue,m.kind==='physical'?180:18);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-es[0].hpLoss);assert.equal(es[0].settledDamage>0,m.power>0);}const z=make({move:m.id,index:-1});z.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(z,m.id,20117),/有 PP/);}});
